items.title: Tell your care team about low readings today
items.text: 5.3% of your readings were below 70 mg/dL and 0.0% below 54 (weeks 11-12); the usual targets are under 4% and under 1%. Low sugar can make you shaky or dizzy. Contact your care team today rather than waiting for your next visit. Ask whether a diabetes medicine needs changing: insulin and sulfonylureas (glipizide, glyburide, glimepiride) are the usual causes of lows, and this data does not record medicines. Until then, don't change your exercise, fasting or meal times.
